patthana16.33:1.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pātabbanahetuko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā soḷasa.
patthana16.33:2.1: dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. ācayagāmittika hetuduke naācayagāmittika nahetudukaṃ
